rows.area: Ambulance Service District 1, 137 Oliver Road, Creole, LA
rows.provider: Cameron Parish Ambulance Service District 1 (Lower Cameron Parish)
rows.transport_basis: CMS 2024 emergency billing; the page names an ambulance service / EMS
rows.evidence: Cameron Parish Police Jury, Ambulance page: "Ambulance Service District 1 (Lower Cameron Parish) ... Ambulance Service District 2 (Hackberry)", each with a board and director/president listed.
rows.note: Two public ambulance service districts named by the parish; the page gives no map, so whether they cover the whole parish (e.g. Johnson Bayou) is not shown. CMS 2024: Cameron Parish EMS Dist 2, Hackberry, 122 emergency transports (share 1.0).

rows.area: parish EMS department
rows.provider: Plaquemines Parish Government Emergency Medical Services
rows.transport_basis: CMS 2024 emergency billing; the page names an ambulance service / EMS
rows.evidence: Plaquemines Parish news alert "Public Safety Sales Tax Rededication": "EMS currently has no dedicated revenue source and relies on annual General Fund appropriations of approximately $2.47 million per year ... parish-wide coverage across the North, South, and East Bank" (as a proposed outcome).
rows.note: Parish department confirmed; "parish-wide coverage" is stated as what the new tax would fund, so current coverage is not shown. CMS 2024: Plaquemines Parish Government Ambulance Department, Belle Chasse, 163 emergency transports (share 1.0).
